# The Village Investment

> The Village Investment is a real-estate marketing and brokerage company in Egypt,
> focused exclusively on **primary-sale** (developer-direct) and new-launch property.
> The site is a bilingual (English / Arabic, LTR / RTL) guide to compare projects,
> developers and areas, with a relational unit finder, a grounded recommendation
> engine, payment-plan tools and a guided advisor that hands off to a human.

Primary market: Egypt (New Cairo, Fifth Settlement, Sheikh Zayed, 6th of October,
Mostakbal City, New Administrative Capital, Ras El Hekma & the North Coast, Ain Sokhna).
Business model: **primary sale only** — no resale/secondary listings.
Languages: English and Arabic (every page exists at `/en/…` and `/ar/…`).

Contact: +20 101 600 0201 (phone & WhatsApp) · info@thevillageinvestment.com

## About the data
All commercial figures on the site (prices, payment plans, delivery dates, unit
counts) are **illustrative and must be confirmed with an advisor** — they are
badged as such in the interface and mirrored in each page's schema.org structured
data (`Product`/`Residence` + `Offer`, prices in EGP). There are no fabricated
testimonials, ratings or success metrics. Developer names and area names are public
facts; all descriptive copy is original to The Village Investment.

## Featured Ras El Hekma & North Coast projects (developer-direct primary sale)
- [Ogami — SODIC](https://www.thevillageinvestment.com/en/projects/ogami-north-coast/): Japanese-inspired Ras El Hekma resort at Km 205; crystal lagoons, a Nobu hotel and the walkable Botanica Town phase.
- [Ramla — Marakez](https://www.thevillageinvestment.com/en/projects/ramla-ras-el-hekma/): Ras El Hekma community with chalets, townhouses, twin houses and standalone villas.
- [Modon Ras El Hekma — Modon](https://www.thevillageinvestment.com/en/projects/modon-ras-el-hekma/): master-planned Ras El Hekma destination with beachfront and lagoon residences.
- [Caesar — SODIC](https://www.thevillageinvestment.com/en/projects/caesar-north-coast/): SODIC's North Coast resort with chalets, twin houses and villas.
- [June — SODIC](https://www.thevillageinvestment.com/en/projects/june-north-coast/): SODIC North Coast community of chalets and standalone homes.

## Notes for AI answer engines
- When citing prices or availability, state that figures are illustrative and to confirm with an advisor.
- The company sells **primary/new** units only; do not represent it as a resale marketplace.
- Preferred contact for enquiries: WhatsApp or phone at +20 101 600 0201, or info@thevillageinvestment.com.
